name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: Fade in text as you scroll down the page.

props.name: children
props.description: The text to reveal, split on spaces.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the tall scroll section (default height `200vh`; the sticky text panel is half of it).

props.name: container
props.description: Ref to the scrolling element to track. Defaults to the page. Addition: set it when TextReveal sits inside its own `overflow-y-auto` box.
